name: nf-company-administration
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island company registration and reporting obligations for 2026. Use for ASIC registration, transferred Norfolk companies, directors, member registers, annual reviews, company size, financial records or accounts lodgement. Covers territorial application, registration facts and consents, officer requirements, ownership notices, current prescribed size thresholds, reporting and audit branches, selected fees and solvency deadlines. Includes primary legislation, authority fee tables and fictional boundary examples. Separates legal registration, tax residence, financial years and review dates. Preserves special transitions, complete workflow outputs and unresolved capital, licensing, director-ID, financial-statement and country conditions.
